In this episode, I test Wegic by building real websites from scratch using AI to see if it can actually replace a traditional web designer. I walk through creating a full pickleball club website with bookings, payments, and merch, then switch gears and build a pizza restaurant website to show how fast you can launch something polished that actually makes money.

I also share how I think about using tools like Wegic to build sites for yourself or sell websites to other business owners, why speed to delivery matters more than time spent, and how this can turn into a legit agency opportunity even if you have zero technical background.

Enjoy!
